Name: drinks n' rock candy retex
Author: kqnuka
Description:
Changes the texture of: Tea, Stardrop tea, coffee, triple shot espresso (/the large coffee), and magic rock candy

Textures can be individually turned off/on; I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for this.

You can choose between the saturated and desaturated versions, along with a toggle for a blue version of the magic rock candy(because why not?)

requires content patcher
